metadata.description: Agent skills to integrate and debug OpenReceive Bitcoin Lightning checkout in Node.js, Rails, Python/Django/FastAPI, PHP/Laravel, WordPress/WooCommerce, and BTCPay Server. Optional USDT, USDC, SOL, and ETH swaps are converted by a configured provider to BTC over Lightning in the merchant's connected wallet; asset and network availability depends on the provider.
